Data Analysis for Fall26 RX

Contents
1. Fuels
2. Burn Severity
3. Tree burn severity

1. Fuels
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

fuels <- read.csv("Fall26RX/fall26rx_pre_post_FUELS.csv")

fuels <- fuels %>% mutate(Block = case_when(Plot == "RAP_07" | Plot == "RAP_08" | Plot == "RAP_11" | Plot == "RAP_12" ~ "Block_CD",
                                            TRUE ~ "Block_A1"))
fuels <- fuels %>% filter(Plot != "RAP_09")%>% filter(Plot != "RAP_10")

fuels2 <- fuels %>% select(c(Plot, Block, PlotStatus, FineWood, TotalWood, Duff, Litter, TotalAll, DuffDep, LittDep, TotDep)) %>%  
  pivot_longer(cols = c(FineWood, TotalWood, Duff, Litter, TotalAll, DuffDep, LittDep, TotDep), names_to = "FuelCategory", values_to = "value")

fuels2$PlotStatus <- factor(fuels2$PlotStatus, levels = c("PreBurn", "PostBurn"), ordered = TRUE)

ggplot(fuels2, aes(x = Block, y = value, fill = PlotStatus)) + geom_boxplot() + facet_wrap(vars(FuelCategory))

fuels_summary <- fuels2 %>% group_by(Block, PlotStatus, FuelCategory) %>% summarise(n = n(),
                                                                      mean = mean(value), sd = sd(value), min = min(value), max = max(value), .groups = "drop")

```


2. Burn Severity
```{r}
bs <- read.csv("Fall26RX/fall26rx_post_BURNSEVERITY.csv")

bs2 <- bs %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(6:15), names_to = c("Category", "Severity"), names_pattern = "([A-Za-z]+)([0-9]+)Pct", values_to = "Percent")
bs2 <- bs2 %>% mutate(Severity = case_when(Severity == 1 ~ "Heavily Burned",
                                           Severity == 2 ~ "Moderately Burned",
                                           Severity == 3 ~ "Lightly Burned", 
                                           Severity == 4 ~ "Scorched", Severity == 5 ~ "Unburned"))

bs2$Severity <- factor(bs2$Severity, levels = c("Unburned", "Scorched", "Lightly Burned", "Moderately Burned", "Heavily Burned"), ordered = TRUE)
bs2 <- bs2 %>% mutate(Block = case_when(Plot == "RAP_07" | Plot == "RAP_08" | Plot == "RAP_11" | Plot == "RAP_12" ~ "Block_CD",
                                            TRUE ~ "Block_A1"))
bs2 <- bs2 %>% mutate(Category = case_when(Category == "Sub" ~ "Substrate", Category == "Veg" ~ "Vegetation"))

bs_summary <- bs2 %>% group_by(Block, Category, Severity) %>% summarise(n = n(),
                                                                      mean = mean(Percent), sd = sd(Percent),  .groups = "drop")


ggplot(bs_summary, aes(x = Severity, y = mean, fill = Category)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge()) + facet_wrap(vars(Block))


```

3. Tree Burn Severity 
```{r}
trees <- read.csv("Fall26RX/fall26rx_pre_post_TREES.csv")

postburn <- trees %>% filter(PlotStatus == "PostBurn")

postburn <- postburn %>% mutate(Block = case_when(Plot == "RAP_07" | Plot == "RAP_08" | Plot == "RAP_11" | Plot == "RAP_12" ~ "Block_CD",
                                            TRUE ~ "Block_A1"))

postburn <- postburn %>% rename(Char_Ht_m = Char.Ht., Scorch_Ht_m = Scorch.Ht., CrownScorch_Pct = Crown.Scorch..) %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(Char_Ht_m, Scorch_Ht_m, CrownScorch_Pct), names_to = "measurement", values_to = "value")

postburn_summary <- postburn %>% group_by(Block, measurement) %>% summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(value), sd = sd(value), .groups = "drop")




```
